messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "it is not effective for glycemic control"
set: ["it is not effective for glycemic control", "3 mg dose is not effective for glycemic control", "increase is needed if additional glycemic control is required", "use effective birth control to avoid pregnancy", "skip it if it is almost time for your next dose", "do not save it for later use", "this is normal and will not make the medicine less effective", "increase in 500 mg increments weekly based on glycemic control and tolerability", "reason for taking it", "increase dosage to 2 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 1 mg if additional glycemic control is needed", "increase dosage to 1 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.5 mg if additional glycemic control is needed", "do not take it for longer than 14 days", "starting is not recommended", "do not let it freeze", "will not be as effective in lowering cholesterol", "use the lowest effective dose for your condition"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
